comment: Share endpoints for the Tax Tally tip box. Templates: {text} = tip text, {url} = tip link, {subject} = share subject; the page URL-encodes each at click time. Canonical copy lives in tax-tally-pubdata (data/social.json); the skill's data/social.json is the build-time source and the two are kept in sync on publish. A 'profiles' section (the firm's own social pages) can be added here when Paul supplies the URLs.
